# `c:pkg:<library>/<header>` resolves through the library's own plugin,
# written in SNGL: it runs pkg-config with gen.exec -- trusted, since it ships
# in the sngl: tree -- and writes the `c.link` a Go target's cgo preamble is
# made from. The Go importer that parsed headers is gone; the program declares
# what it calls with `#[cnative]`.
env SNGL_GENCACHE_DIR=$WORK/store

# A library pkg-config does not know fails the import, saying so.
! sngl check missing/app.sngl
stderr 'missing/app.sngl:1:1: import "c:pkg:nonexistent-lib-xyz-9999/x.h": scheme "c": pkg-config --cflags nonexistent-lib-xyz-9999 failed'

# An import naming no header cannot be included.
! sngl check noheader/app.sngl
stderr 'import "c:pkg:gtk4": scheme "c": c:pkg:gtk4 names no header: write c:pkg:<library>/<header>'

# The library name is the repository's, and pkg-config runs unasked for this
# plugin: one that reads as a flag is refused rather than handed over.
! sngl check flag/app.sngl
stderr 'c:pkg:--with-path=/tmp/x.h names no library: "--with-path=" reads as a pkg-config flag'

[!gtk4] skip 'needs pkg-config and GTK 4'

sngl generate --platform=fyne --lang=go -o out --debug gtk/app.sngl
grep '^#cgo CFLAGS: .*-I/[^ ]*gtk-4' out/model.go
grep '^#cgo LDFLAGS: .*-lgtk-4' out/model.go
grep '^#include <gtk/gtk.h>$' out/model.go
grep 'm.v = int\(C.gtk_get_major_version\(\)\)' out/model.go
! stderr 'gencache hit" req="sngl.scheme'

# The package the plugin wrote is stored, behind the .pc file pkg-config read:
# a second build runs no pkg-config.
sngl generate --platform=fyne --lang=go -o out --debug gtk/app.sngl
stderr 'gencache hit" req="sngl.scheme'
! stderr 'exec.*pkg-config'

-- missing/app.sngl --
import "c:pkg:nonexistent-lib-xyz-9999/x.h"

const v = 1
-- noheader/app.sngl --
import "c:pkg:gtk4"

const v = 1
-- flag/app.sngl --
import "c:pkg:--with-path=/tmp/x.h"

const v = 1
-- gtk/app.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import macro "sngl:macro"
import "c:pkg:gtk4/gtk/gtk.h"

// GTK's major version, from the library the program links.
#[macro.cnative("gtk_get_major_version")]
func gtkMajor() int

var v = 0

ui.window(title="t") {
    ui.button(text="v{v}", @click {
        v = gtkMajor()
    })
}
